purpose: Current direct single-holder Responsibility relation from an Activity to a Person in the bounded B09 temporal subset.

columns.name: activity_ref
columns.meaning: Canonical Activity whose current accountability is described.

columns.name: responsible_person_ref
columns.meaning: Person currently bearing Responsibility in the activated simple-holder subset; Account identity is not required.

columns.name: established_at
columns.meaning: Server-side accepted instant supplied by the B09-B guarded operation.

primary_key.name: pk_activity_responsibility
primary_key.reason: B09 activates one current simple Responsibility holder per Activity; joint/collective semantics remain deferred rather than guessed.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_responsibility_activity
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Responsibility changes do not change Activity identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_activity_responsibility_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: B09 activates Person as the eligible holder subset; Person != Account and Responsibility != performer/participant.

indexes.name: pk_activity_responsibility
indexes.reason: One current simple holder per Activity in B09.

indexes.name: ix_activity_responsibility_person_activity
indexes.reason: Reverse lookup of Activities currently borne by a Person.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Not Domain MaterialState; current direct semantic relation only.
state_history.current_binding: At most one current simple Responsibility Person for an Activity in B09.
state_history.chronology: B09-B records each accepted change in activity_responsibility_operation; this table remains the current holder only.
state_history.immutability_policy: No direct runtime writes; current holder changes only through set_self_activity_responsibility.

lifecycle.retention: Absence means no current Responsibility assertion in this activated subset, not explicit open/unassigned state.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime raw DELETE is denied; B09-B clears by capability.

obligations: Responsibility remains distinct from requester, expected performer, actual performer, Participation and Authority.
Holder is a Person NativeRef and does not require an Account.
Joint/collective/open/transfer semantics are not fabricated by the simple B09-A persistence subset.
